items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: I had Al Tinney here. And Al Tinney was the one who ran those things at Clark Monroe’s.

ctx.x: Really. A pain in the neck and a funny guy?

Oh yeah. He’s a grouch. He thinks he’s got all the answers and everything. So I remember I had Mark Murphy singing with Sonny Rollins. And he comes behind, in the room behind, while Mark is singing, doing a whole tribute to Miles and to Clifford Brown. And he goes, “So what’s this guy got on Joe Williams?” Like that. I go, “What’s he got on Joe Williams, they’re friends. Why? What’s the problem?” “He ain’t got nothin’ on Joe Williams.” I said, “well he scats a lot better than Joe Williams, but Joe has this…
Yes. I did an interview with him.
